description: Three-band saturator: the input is split into a low, a middle and a high band, each driven into its own waveshaper and mixed back against its dry band, with all three bands out separately and summed

params.text: Sets how hard its band is driven into the waveshaper, 0.1 to 10
Crossfades its band's waveshaper between three curves: a symmetrical sigmoid at 0, a full-wave rectified one at 1 and a sine fold at 2
Bends the waveshaper of its band, -1 to 1, and moves that band's filter frequency two octaves either way at the same time
Crossfades that band's output between the untouched band at fully counter-clockwise and the saturated band at fully clockwise

inputs.text: The audio to be split into all three bands
Audio added to the low band alone, on top of whatever the ALL input carries
Audio added to the middle band alone, on top of whatever the ALL input carries
Audio added to the high band alone, on top of whatever the ALL input carries
Divided by 2 and added to the Drive knob of its band, the total clamped to 0.1 and 10
Divided by 5 and added to the Morph knob of its band, the total clamped to 0 and 2
Divided by 5 and added to the Curve knob of its band, the total clamped to -1 and 1
Divided by 5 and added to the Mix knob of its band, the total clamped to 0 and 1

outputs.text: The three band outputs added together and divided by three
The low band, saturated and mixed back against its dry signal; its filter is a lowpass at 450Hz with the Curve knob centred
The middle band, saturated and mixed back against its dry signal; its filter is a bandpass at 850Hz with the Curve knob centred
The high band, saturated and mixed back against its dry signal; its filter is a highpass at 1500Hz with the Curve knob centred

notes: every Mix knob comes up fully counter-clockwise, which is all dry, so the module passes its input through until at least one of them is turned up
each band's saturated signal is high-passed at 15.2Hz before the mix, because the rectifying curves put a DC offset on it
the Curve controls do two things at once: they bend the waveshaper and they move the band's filter frequency, so turning one changes the crossover as well as the tone
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
